tools.name: aladtec_list_members
tools.description: List members with their Member Database attributes, sorted by last name. Attributes not enabled for the API return null. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_employee_types
tools.description: List the employee types of the system, for example full time or part time. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_custom_attributes
tools.description: List the custom Member Database attribute definitions. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_get_availability
tools.description: Get the availability of members for a date and time range. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_time_off
tools.description: List time off requests in a range. Approved requests only, unless statuses includes pending. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_schedules
tools.description: List the schedules of the system, in the order set on the Setup page. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_position_qualifications
tools.description: List the unique position qualifications. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_scheduled_time
tools.description: List scheduled time ranges for a period, with the member and position for each. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_open_time
tools.description: List time ranges where no member is scheduled, for finding shifts that need cover. Up to one month per request. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_members_scheduled_now
tools.description: List each member scheduled at the time of the request, with the schedule and position. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_schedule_notes
tools.description: List schedule notes by calendar date. Up to one year per request. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_extra_hours
tools.description: List extra hours in a past period. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_paycodes
tools.description: List the active paycodes that can be applied to time clock time. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_kiosks
tools.description: List the active kiosks that members use to clock in and out. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_time_clock_records
tools.description: List time clock records in a range. Members still clocked in are left out. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_clocked_in_members
tools.description: List the members clocked in at the time of the request. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_events
tools.description: List events (title, description, location) in a date and time range. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_shift_labels
tools.description: List shift labels, such as A/B/C or Red/Gold/Black, for a date range. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_work_groups
tools.description: List all work groups, which hold the scheduling and overtime rules for members. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_time_types
tools.description: List the unique time types that can be applied to scheduled time. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_list_accrual_banks
tools.description: List all time off accrual banks. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_get_accrual_balances
tools.description: Get the hours in each accrual bank for a list of members. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_get_configuration
tools.description: Get the configuration settings of the system. Read only.

tools.name: aladtec_get_payroll_report
tools.description: Run the payroll report export for a range. Pass next_token from the previous reply to get the next page. Read only.
